question: The phone boot upload pass (uploadLayerNow) logs GL_INVALID_OPERATION on every draw: why, and what does making the draws valid cost a phone?
cause: With the sun pass held no shadow map exists; three r185 falls back to a DepthTexture it never uploads for the directionalShadowMap[] sampler array, so WebGLState binds its 1x1 RGBA colour texture to a sampler2DShadow and Chrome refuses the draw: "glMultiDrawElementsANGLE: Mismatch between texture format and sampler type (signed/unsigned/float/shadow)".
answer: Letting the draws run (valid) removes the errors but costs +67 to +74 MB of GPU-process PSS, still held after the town settles. Holding the draw calls for the pass (held) removes the errors at the memory of before: GPU-process PSS within run-to-run noise, the GL meter identical.
profile: /1904/ phone 390x780 dpr3 touch, headless Chromium (SwiftShader), published mirror; three interleaved rounds (held/before/valid, valid/held/before, before/valid/held), each round under the shared gate lock

tools.probe: ad hoc scratch probe, not committed: an init script wraps the WebGL2 draw calls and WEBGL_multi_draw with getError, attributed by stack to uploadLayerNow (a held draw never reaches the wrapper, so held reads 0 draws seen); Chrome console GL messages counted (Chrome caps them per context); Pss from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup of the browser --type=gpu-process and renderer every 200 ms; ready = __chicago4d.ready, settled = entered at spawn, 3 frames, 1 s, GC, 3 s

arms.before: origin/dev: the pass draws with the sun pass held; every draw refused
arms.valid: tried, not shipped: the sun lent a 1x1 comparing depth map for the pass, so the draws run
arms.held: shipped: the pass runs with the context draw calls held (no-op), uploads unchanged

desktop.note: desktop never runs the upload pass (main.js settleOnGpu returns unless the pointer is coarse); 1280x800 boot, one run each
